candidates.reason: Clean two-column banner: headline, copy and CTA are grouped on the right with good hierarchy. The logo keeps its sun mark and the headline is strong, but the CTA has been cut off from its copy and stacked under the product. Its top almost touches the can's base, and it is pinned close to the bottom-left edges. The body copy wraps to four short lines, leaving the right column ragged.

The best grouping and fidelity: the logo keeps its sun mark, and headline, copy and CTA read in order down the right side.
